messages:
Emilia (CEO): Looping everyone back into the all-hands reliability follow-up. RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. Post Qs and confirm action completion here.

Sam (VP Eng): Quick recap: ~35m degradation from autoscaler policy flip + cache TTL override after weekend deploy. Mitigated via manual scale + rollback.

Rohit (SRE Lead): RCA updated; attached missing cache log. Added alert infra:cache-ttl-drift. My actions: finalize RCA and add runbook entries.

Priya (Runtime eng): Rolled back quantized config during the 02:00 UTC window; PR merged. I'm gating the flag behind a feature toggle and adding a CI check.

Jess (Customer Ops): Drafted customer note and impacted-account sheet: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-comm-draft. Posting for Legal/Finance review.

Tara (Product): Product will add "deploy safety checklist" to roadmap and own severity mapping.

Diego (Oncall): Oncall ran 48h canary; metrics stable. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary.

Sam (VP Eng): Action items recap: Rohit 61 attach logs + runbook (due 2026-03-31) ; Priya 61 gate flag + CI (due 2026-04-06) ; Jess 61 send comms after legal review (due 2026-03-31) ; Tara 61 checklist in backlog ; Diego 61 share canary export. React when done.

Jess (Customer Ops): Question for leadership: proactive notify top-25 accounts?

Emilia (CEO): Yes for top-25 and regulated customers. Others on demand.

Priya (Runtime eng): note for engs: grep for TTL override: kubectl logs -l app=ingress-cache -n prod | grep 'meta:ttl_override' -n -C2

Sam (VP Eng): Thanks all. I'll ping in 72h for status updates and then close items marked done. Keep follow-ups in-thread.
